faqs.question: How do payouts work at BrightFunded?
faqs.answer: BrightFunded processes payouts on a bi-weekly basis (every 14 days) after your first trade on the funded account. The default profit split is 80% in favor of the trader, which can scale up to 90% if you qualify for the scaling plan. Payout requests are typically processed within 24 hours.

seo.title: BrightFunded Payout Process & Schedule
seo.metaDescription: Learn how payouts work at BrightFunded, including the 14-day bi-weekly schedule, 80% to 90% profit split, and 24-hour processing time.

faqs.question: What are the drawdown limits at BrightFunded?
faqs.answer: BrightFunded enforces a 5% daily drawdown limit and a 10% maximum drawdown limit. The daily drawdown is calculated based on the previous day's ending balance or equity (whichever is higher) at midnight CE(S)T. Exceeding these limits will result in immediate account breach and termination.

seo.title: BrightFunded Drawdown Limits Explained

faqs.question: Is the challenge fee refundable?
faqs.answer: Yes, the registration fee you pay for the BrightFunded challenge is fully refundable. It will be added to your very first successful payout once you reach the funded stage and complete your first profitable trading cycle.

faqs.question: What payout methods are supported by BrightFunded?
faqs.answer: BrightFunded supports multiple payout methods to ensure convenient withdrawals. These include Rise (for global bank transfers and e-wallet payouts), direct Bank Transfers, and popular Cryptocurrencies such as USDT. Payouts are processed quickly, often within 24 hours.
